title: Verify finite Rayleigh witnesses without a stationary-normalizer oracle
statement: For a rational finite-support f with sum w f=0, compute A=sum w f^2>0 and D=(1/2)sum_{x,r} w(x)kappa_r(x)_y_r [f(x+nu_r)-f(x)]^2. Only support states and their reaction predecessors/successors contribute; enabled class membership is checked exactly. The stationary normalizer cancels, E/Var=D/A. Integer cross-multiplication jD<=A verifies a physical-time1/j witness. Factorials, rational denominators, reaction evaluation, membership and output encodings are paid; exact finite verification does not decide the infimum over all finite supports.
